About

Each dot is one forecasting model. The models on the left were made by hand; the rest were bred: every generation keeps the best few and makes new ones from the better ones by changing or combining their formulas. A thin line to the right of a dot shows how many generations it stayed among the best; lines to the left join it to its parents (the second parent dashed).

Every model starts from our forecast with the forecast wind (adv1) and corrects it with a few signals known at the time of the forecast. The corrections are fitted afresh each day on everything measured before that day.

Score: the squared miss divided by what the reference forecast gets wrong at that lead, averaged; lower is better, 1 is as bad as the reference. The selection days chose the models; the held-out days were never used for choosing.
